name: movie-server
description: Home server for managing torrent-based downloads with web UI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @movie-server/api" "npm run dev -w @movie-server/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @movie-server/shared && npm run build -w @movie-server/api && npm run build -w @movie-server/web && npm run build -w @movie-server/whatsapp-agent
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web --kill-others "npm run start -w @movie-server/api" "npm run start -w @movie-server/web"
scripts.update: git pull && npm run build && launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.michael.server.plist && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.michael.server.plist
scripts.debug: git pull && launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.michael.server.plist && npm run dev
